summary: Writes bytes to a buffered output stream. While a requested count a3 remains, it copies into an internal buffer (pointer at this+0x20, remaining space at this+0x30) when both are valid, using MemoryCopy_cc00; otherwise it calls the vtable method at obj+0x4 (index 1) to flush or write a single byte. Returns the total number of bytes written.

operations.description: Initialize v8 to 0, the running total of bytes written.
while (a3 > 0) — iterate until the requested byte count a3 is fully written.
If the buffer pointer at this+0x20 is non-null and the remaining space at this+0x30 is greater than 0, take the buffered-copy path.
Compute v6 = min(a3, remaining space at this+0x30), the number of bytes that fit this iteration.
MemoryCopy_cc00 copies v6 bytes from the input buffer a2 into the internal buffer at this+0x20.
Advance the write state: v8 += v6, a3 -= v6, remaining space at this+0x30 -= v6, a2 += v6, and buffer pointer at this+0x20 += v6.
When the buffer path is unavailable, invoke the flush/write method stored in the vtable at obj+0x4 (index 1) with one byte read from a2.
If the flush/write call returns -1 (error), return v8 early.
Otherwise advance a2, increment v8, and decrement a3.
Return v8, the total number of bytes written.
